notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other creatures that are valid targets for Seething Anger.
description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, targeting Zada.
Zada and Storm-Kiln Artist triggers.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zada trigger, copying Seething Anger for each creature you control.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy made this way, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Seething Anger copies, giving all other creatures +3/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving Zada +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}.
Repeat.
